`stock_report.py` now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than what you'd expect to sell in the 6 days an order takes to arrive. The 6 is `SUPPLIER_LEAD_TIME_DAYS` at the top of the file.

I ran it on your current `inventory.csv` and two items are newly flagged:

| SKU | Item | On hand | Expected sales in 6 days | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CF-1K | House blend 1kg | 9 | 14.4 | REORDER |
| OT-1L | Oat milk 1L | 30 | 45 | REORDER |
| FL-100 | Paper filters x100 | 0 | 7.2 | OUT |

The other three have enough to cover the 6 days and still show `ok`.

- **`OUT` is kept:** an empty shelf still shows `OUT` rather than `REORDER`, so you can tell "order now" from "already gone".
- **No safety margin:** an item with exactly 6 days of stock left shows `ok`, since an order placed that day arrives just as the shelf empties. If you'd rather be warned a day or two earlier, raise the number at the top.
